Rust JavaScript package manager

Usage: jsm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init             
  add              
  install          
  remove           
  run              
  exec             
  list             
  why              
  config           
  store            
  versions         
  doctor           
  lock             
  completion       
  help             
  link             
  unlink           
  capabilities     
  x                
  serve            
  cache            
  ui               
  plugin           
  daemon           
  node             
  workspaces       
  approve-scripts  
  patch            
  patch-commit     
  migrate          
  audit            
  deploy           
  build            
  update           
  outdated         
  diff             
  dupes            
  unused           
  history          
  undo             
  redo             
  snapshot         
  switch           

Options:
      --cwd <CWD>                                  [default: .]
      --json                                       
      --quiet                                      
      --verbose                                    
      --offline                                    
      --prefer-offline                             
      --prefer-store                               
      --store-dir <STORE_DIR>                      
      --registry <REGISTRY>                        
      --no-color                                   
      --non-interactive                            
  -r, --recursive                                  
      --filter <FILTER>                            
      --progress <PROGRESS>                        [default: auto] [possible values: auto, ndjson]
      --linker <LINKER>                            [default: isolated]
      --min-release-age <MIN_RELEASE_AGE>          
      --resolution <RESOLUTION>                    [default: highest]
      --before <BEFORE>                            
      --ignore-scripts                             
      --explain                                    
      --network-concurrency <NETWORK_CONCURRENCY>  
      --config <CONFIG>                            
      --trace <FILE>                               Write a Chrome trace for diagnostic runs
  -h, --help                                       Print help
  -V, --version                                    Print version
